posts.issue: Products in different categories never appear together, hurting new and niche items.

posts.title: From Scoring to Spelling: Rebuilding Ads Retrieval at Instacart
posts.summary: They replaced a scoring model with a generative transformer that predicts the next product token in a shopping session, improving contextual relevance.

posts.title: Unlocking a New Way to Build Enterprise Data Apps with Microsoft Fabric
posts.summary: They created Rayfin, an open‑source SDK that turns a simple description into backend code, adds security and compliance, and deploys the app directly to Microsoft Fabric.
posts.issue: Teams spent weeks setting up authentication, APIs, and governance to turn data into production apps.

posts.title: Slack AI: The Path to Multi-Cloud
posts.summary: Built a multi‑cloud system that runs enterprise LLMs across several providers, balancing load to cut latency and avoid outages.
posts.issue: Users needed faster, more reliable LLM responses without high infrastructure risk.

posts.title: The ultimate guide to knowledge management for your Service Agent

posts.summary: They connected their knowledge base to an LLM with a Retrieval‑Augmented Generation pipeline, using whole support articles stored in a vector store and routing queries to specialized workflows.

posts.result: Higher success rates and fewer steps on web browsing and coding tasks

posts.issue: Developers worry AI‑generated code might be unsafe or break other users' environments.

posts.summary: Implemented context‑management mechanisms that synchronize agents, preserve shared state, and guide reasoning across extended interactions.

posts.result: Figures and reviews outperform existing automated baselines

posts.issue: Training large models took too long, slowing down product updates and increasing expenses.

posts.title: Predicting Rider Conversion in Sparse Data Environments with Bayesian Trees
posts.summary: They built a Bayesian tree model that shares information across similar contexts, avoiding over‑fitting and running fast enough for live predictions.
posts.issue: Rider conversion rates were hard to predict because data for specific contexts was extremely sparse.

posts.summary: They built a framework that splits regions and uses surrogate metrics to predict long‑term outcomes of pricing and incentive changes in the marketplace.
posts.issue: Deciding how much to spend on driver incentives or rider prices without knowing long‑term effects was risky.

posts.issue: Multiple AI agents editing the same code caused merge conflicts and coordination problems.

posts.summary: They added a Multigate Mixture of Experts architecture and used add‑to‑cart events as an extra training signal to better predict purchase intent and rank ads.
posts.issue: Buyers struggled to find the right items and sellers couldn’t reach interested customers.

posts.issue: Developers had to choose an artifact type early and use a separate design mode, slowing and complicating app creation.

posts.title: Improving breast cancer screening workflows with machine learning
posts.summary: They built an AI system to act as a second reader, ran large retrospective and prospective studies, and showed it can match or improve detection while easing workload.
posts.issue: A shortage of radiologists threatens the double‑read breast cancer screening process.

posts.title: Search Quality Assurance with AI as a Judge
posts.summary: They built an LLM-as-a-judge system that automatically evaluates search relevance at scale, using clustered real queries and NER to cover all search scenarios before launch.
posts.issue: New markets lacked user data, so search quality was only checked after launch, causing slow fixes.

posts.summary: Created a connector that lets Replit’s coding agent call Databricks APIs, so apps can read and write trusted data without manual credential handling.
posts.issue: Teams needed to build apps that could safely use sensitive, governed enterprise data.

posts.summary: She used Replit Agent to write and run the 3D AR code, iterating daily and deploying a TestFlight build within a week.

posts.summary: Created an AI‑native platform that uses LLMs to generate, evaluate, and retrieve content, delivering more relevant and cohesive recommendations on the Shopping Hub.

posts.summary: Created data pipelines and attribution models that rank and filter results, showing only the most relevant, personalized experiences.

posts.summary: They built an AI‑driven translation pipeline that drafts translations with LLMs, then lets linguists review them, keeping quality high while cutting turnaround to minutes.
posts.issue: Users needed new languages quickly, but human translation was slow and expensive.
